ar.title: لون السماء في 36 ثانية: الأزرق والأحمر
ar.description:
لماذا السماء زرقاء والغروب أحمر؟ ضوء الشمس الأبيض خليط من كل الألوان. عندما يدخل الهواء تصطدم الألوان بجزيئاته الصغيرة، فيتشتت الأزرق في كل اتجاه أكثر من غيره، فتبدو السماء زرقاء.
وقت الغروب يمر الضوء في هواء أطول بكثير، فيتشتت الأزرق قبل أن يصلك ولا يبقى إلا الأحمر والبرتقالي.

#علوم #فيزياء #shorts

en.title: Blue Sky, Red Sunset: 1 Simple Reason
en.description:
Why is the sky blue and the sunset red? Sunlight looks white but is a mix of all colors. When it enters the air, it hits tiny air molecules and blue light scatters in every direction far more than red, so the sky looks blue (Rayleigh scattering).
At sunset, light crosses much more air, so the blue scatters away before reaching you and only red and orange remain.

#science #physics #shorts
en.first_comment: Blue noon sky or red sunset: which do you prefer? 👇

hooks.ar: السماء تحمرّ وقت الغروب لسبب واحد بسيط، ما هو؟
hooks.en: Your sky turns red at sunset for 1 simple reason. Why?
Why is your sky blue at noon but red at sunset?
The same sun paints your sky blue, then red. How?
The sky isn't blue. Air throws blue light at you. Why?
Sunlight is white, so why is your sky blue?

test: new hook formula: 'one simple reason' teaser; myth/explanation style
facts: Sunlight is a mix of colors (visible spectrum) (standard physics; NASA Space Place 'Why is the sky blue?').
Air molecules scatter shorter (blue) wavelengths much more than longer (red) ones: Rayleigh scattering (NASA Space Place; NOAA SciJinks).
At sunrise/sunset sunlight passes through more atmosphere, so blue is scattered out and reds/oranges reach the eye (NOAA SciJinks 'Why is the sky blue / sunsets red').
Violet-vs-blue detail omitted for simplicity; no numbers used.
